biggestGap: Limb-root mass: dragon thighs and forearms are equal-width tubes (thigh ~= ankle width) where the WoW drake and Valheim boar taper ~3:1 from a bulging haunch/shoulder down to the foot; the same tube-uniformity kills the serpent's neck-to-body taper. Put mass at the roots, taper hard toward the extremities.
notes: All six panels on all three sheets frame their subject; the prior broken 3/4 panel is fixed (dragon front panel has an odd wings-raised read, but that is pose, not framing). DRAGON vs WoW black drake + Valheim boar: reference wins - the drake carries ~3:1 root-to-extremity limb taper and its wing structure reads through distinct finger ridges, while ours stands on stick-width legs and the folded wing reads as a shapeless dark tarp; head sculpt and silhouette are respectable, the failure is below the neck. SERPENT vs Valheim serpent render: reference wins decisively - Valheim is all head carriage with spiky fins, hard red/teal value breaks, and clean neck taper, while ours balloons into a fat smooth mid-body with three pea-sized knob-heads on a thin neck and one uninterrupted green gradient; the silhouette reads as a slug with bumps. OOZE judged against my knowledge of shipped slimes (Valheim blob, WoW oozes - no gel image ref exists): closest call and best sheet - the translucent shell over inner lobes and suspended core is a real gel read the Valheim blob does not attempt, but it lacks drip lobes pooling at the ground line and any specular/value break on the dome, so it sits as a matte cluster of soft balls; a hesitant tie, which is a loss. Overall: ooze near, dragon torso-up near, serpent far.
